sop_title: Clearing Temporary Receipt Files on Orders API
purpose: To resolve disk full errors on the orders-api container by cleaning up old temporary receipt files.
when_to_use: Use when orders-api reports OSError [Errno 28] No space left on device or health check reports a failing disk.
prerequisites: kubectl access to the shop namespace

steps.instruction: Check disk usage to confirm the problem
Clear temporary files to fix the disk space issue
Check the health to confirm the fix
steps.expect: status healthy or no longer degraded by disk

verification: Run curl -s http://orders-api:8080/health and verify status is healthy or no longer degraded by disk.
Run df -h /var/lib/shoplite inside the container and verify disk usage is below 100%.

rollback.instruction: Deleted temporary files cannot be restored. If application functionality requires the deleted files, regenerate the receipts or restart the application process to recreate necessary temporary structures.

sop_change: New SOP created to handle OrdersApiDiskFull incidents.
short_description: orders-api ran out of disk space due to accumulated temporary receipt files in /var/lib/shoplite/tmp.
problem_statement: The orders-api service experienced an OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device because /var/lib/shoplite reached 100% usage.
impact: orders-api health status became degraded due to a failing disk, causing temporary receipt creation failures.
trigger: Accumulation of temporary files in /var/lib/shoplite/tmp older than 1 day.
immediate_resolution: Cleared old temporary files using the find command to delete files older than 1 day under /var/lib/shoplite/tmp.
root_causes: Temporary receipt files accumulated in /var/lib/shoplite/tmp without an automated cleanup mechanism.

timeline.event: Engineer encountered OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device and health check confirmed disk failure.
Engineer asked about the safety of step 2.
Engineer confirmed completion of the steps.

action_items: Implement an automated cleanup cron job or lifecycle policy for /var/lib/shoplite/tmp to prevent disk exhaustion.
